comment: Live 2.x server contract, verified empirically against an isolated opencode serve v2.0.24 (2026-10-07, AGF-1 QA). Synthetic password only; disposable server. Every /api route requires HTTP Basic auth (username 'opencode' by default; password env OPENCODE_PASSWORD, fallback OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD — a server started with neither generates a random password the loop cannot learn). Non-/api paths serve the SPA.

GET /api/session.paginated: ?cursor=<cursor.next> until next is null; page limit fails closed

POST /api/session/{id}/prompt.notes: Synchronous; 2xx confirms delivery of the user message without a configured model. prompt_async and message POST routes do NOT exist on 2.0.24 (404).

rejected_assumptions.GET /global/health: serves the SPA HTML (not JSON); the plugin probe uses GET /api/info
rejected_assumptions.bare /session routes: unauthenticated/non-prefixed paths do not exist; 401 on /api without Basic auth
